scientific_intent.scientific_operator: Absolute Pearson correlation on three gene-expression sign-condition masks, greedy bicluster augmentation/strict largest-candidate selection and overlap-based merging.
scientific_intent.community_use: Co-expression subgroup discovery in expression-matrix analysis, as stated by source authors. Synthetic planted fixtures only; no disease mechanism, causal regulation, clinical, or real-data discovery validation.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact selected and temporary membership masks, counts, stored scores, merged states, printed indices. Independent Float64 conditional Pearson decisions and complete augmentation/selection/merge oracle; minimum decision margin >0.064. Intermediate Float32 Pearson values are not emitted, so no universal pointwise correlation error certificate.
limitations: Conditional native correction; excluded untouched-native aggregate.
Missing original input/reference-output assets; named 12×32,17×64,33×200 planted matrices, max base seeds4/5/7,repeat3.
No expression equal to its supplied gene mean; source unassigned zero-deviation edge outside scope. Degenerate Pearson variance retains IEEE NaN-as-false threshold comparison behavior.
Full GPU algorithm and CPU merge/printed outputs verified; source file reader/variance ordering, allocation-inclusive CLI, and real biology unmeasured.

keyconfounds: One block of five trials per model; no causal framework ranking without repeated counterbalanced measurements/profiles.
Source mapping one GPU thread per base-gene block retained, only4/5/7 blocks; exposes little parallelism regardless of language.
KA/JACC inherit translated CUDAjl math and common host harness; ordered marginal effort, not independent translation.
Native source correction changes scientific output contract explicitly, excludes untouched-source performance aggregate.
KA uses own framework local memory; JACC faithfully reserves source scratch through CUDA-specific static-shared interop. No cross-backend portability claim.
Gene-expression input reader and variance sorting, full allocation-inclusive CLI and missing original real dataset are unmeasured.
